GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 7th, 5 Lengths @ 800m. similar Straightening Up . Just Held Ground # never came into it
Jumped Ok sat rail 3l off, improved off rail turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, running on took over passing 100m and held narrow margin to the line # had run/did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination after getting its hind leg up on the running board in the barriers and was passed suitable to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat near last 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no threat

Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear 3 Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 450m. Pressured Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Worked home steadily without threatening in last 200m. # OK for further.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Wide Just Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths @ 700m. 3 Wide Straightening Up Hard Ridden into Straight . Gradually Gave Ground , all the way to last (vetted - no problems) # 3w/faded away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Bumped wider near the 200m. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 3l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off limited room, soon clear, 3l off 200m, 2 Lengths off 100m, hit line strong late # minor excuses

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, shuffled back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, raced tightly early in Straight then kept improving to the line. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 1kg overweight.] # battled on fairly
Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, running on half off 100m, kept finding the line, took over 50m drew clear late # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 6l off, well back turn in traffic, Straightened Up well off limited room, clear approaching 200m and ran on strong # held up/ran on
bumped start Worse than midfield 8l 1 off home turn 6l Made Some Ground late without threatening top four # one paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55kg. Was bumped on jumping by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from a low draw. Settled Down 6th on rail 5 Lengths @ 900m. railed Straightening Up all Clear on rail and close-up now. Quickly Took over! came Clear # rails run/sound win
